title: Pleiades Gaia colour–magnitude sequence audit
question: How narrow is the selected Pleiades sequence, and how sensitive is it to astrometric quality cuts?
results: median inverse-parallax distance 136.04 pc; bootstrap 68% 135.92–136.19 pc
validation: Sequence width and distance are repeated across four RUWE thresholds.
provenance: source-level parallax, photometry, proper motion, and RUWE retained
limitations: inverse parallax is used only at high S/N
cubic sequence is empirical, not an isochrone
unresolved binaries and extinction broaden the sequence
